subject: Maths
title: Percentages as fractions and decimals
subtitle: Decimals and Percentages · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can convert between percentages, fractions and decimals fluently.

key_vocab.definition: Every percentage can be written as a fraction (over 100, then simplify) or a decimal (divide by 100).

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can convert between percentages, fractions and decimals fluently.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: percentage -- Every percentage can be written as a fraction (over 100, then simplify) or a decimal (divide by 100).

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
% to fraction: put over 100, simplify. % to decimal: divide by 100. Reverse to go back.
45% = &frac{45}{100} = &frac{9}{20} = 0.45
Percentage means per hundred

Key examples:
  ✓ 50% = &frac{1}{2} = 0.5  (half)
  ✓ 20% = &frac{1}{5} = 0.2  (fifth)
  ✓ 125% = &frac{5}{4} = 1.25  (more than 100%)
  ✗ 33% = &frac{1}{3}  (&frac{1}{3} = 33.3...%)
  ✗ 0.5% = &frac{1}{2}  (0.5% = &frac{1}{200})

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – percentage to fraction
  Convert 60% to a fraction in simplest form.
  Write as &frac{60}{100}
  HCF of 60 and 100 is 20
  &frac{60}{100} = &frac{3}{5}
  = &frac{3}{5}
  (Divide numerator and denominator by the HCF.)

Example 2 – percentage to decimal
  Convert 37.5% to a decimal.
  Divide by 100
  37.5 ÷ 100 = 0.375
  = 0.375
  = 0.375
  (Move the decimal point two places left.)

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ 50% = 0.5 = &frac{1}{2}
✗ 0.7 = 7%
✓ 125% = 1.25
✗ &frac{1}{3} = 33%
✓ To convert a decimal to %, multiply by 100
